name: Ruellia

project_scope.note: The source pool contains historical names now represented by canonical Ruellia ciliatiflora. Preserve those names for provenance and field-literature continuity without creating duplicate learner pages.

priority: terminal/peduncled versus axillary/nearly sessile flower position
long-pilose versus fine short pubescence versus nearly glabrous foliage
study_strategy.warning: Do not identify these from purple flower color alone. Flower position and hair type are the fastest field split.

quick_key.if: purple/violet flowers raised above the foliage on conspicuous peduncled branching terminal or upper-axillary cymes; foliage mostly glabrous to inconspicuously hairy
quick_key.then: Ruellia ciliatiflora (= R. nudiflora / R. occidentalis source concepts)

quick_key.if: purple flowers/cymes essentially sessile in the leaf axils; stems and leaves finely short-pubescent; capsule with only 2–4 seeds
purple flowers nearly sessile in leaf axils AND stems/leaves/margins conspicuously long-pilose or shaggy
large white to pale flowers in a terminal branching panicle; upper inflorescence and calyx densely stalked-glandular-hairy

taxonomy_note: Current Kew/POWO accepts Ruellia ciliatiflora Hook. and places Ruellia nudiflora and Ruellia occidentalis in synonymy. The project keeps historical Texas source names as aliases while using one canonical R. ciliatiflora learner.
